output.reason: Two weeks postpartum with detachment, constant crying and new frightening thoughts of harming the baby requires immediate in-person emergency psychiatric assessment and infant safety planning today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Thoughts of harming your baby two weeks after birth need urgent in-person mental health assessment. Have another adult stay with you and the baby and care for the baby until you are seen; do not go alone if you can avoid it. If you feel you might act on these thoughts, or you see or hear things others don't, call 911 immediately.
differential: Postpartum depression with intrusive thoughts of infant harm
